title: Prove higher-power phase descent and exact eight-row capacity four
body:
**Scoped alphabet theorem: for every prime q>=5 and positive a,b, a q+3-row matrix with at least four pairwise orthogonal columns over mu_(3^a q^b) can be changed by row and column phases into a matrix over mu_(3q).** Consequently, the maximum number of orthogonal eight-entry columns is **exactly four for every mu_(3^a 5^b)**. This resolves the higher-power question from [PR #7769](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7769). **No new kappa** or physical supplier follows.

Read the [all-power proof and sharpness construction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/00daa049c349349f7db27ae7ddaf2f56116aaf79/research/two-prime-alphabet-descent/PROOF.md), [exact certificates](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/00daa049c349349f7db27ae7ddaf2f56116aaf79/research/two-prime-alphabet-descent/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/00daa049c349349f7db27ae7ddaf2f56116aaf79/research/two-prime-alphabet-descent/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/00daa049c349349f7db27ae7ddaf2f56116aaf79/research/two-prime-alphabet-descent/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/00daa049c349349f7db27ae7ddaf2f56116aaf79/research/two-prime-alphabet-descent/CREDITS.md).

| Statement | Exact scope |
| --- | --- |
| Alphabet descent | q prime >=5, a,b>=1, q+3 rows, at least four orthogonal columns |
| Exact capacity four | Eight rows, every alphabet mu_(3^a 5^b) |
| Sharp threshold | Three-column higher-phase examples cannot descend when 3^a q^b>3q |

Lam and Leung's classical two-prime cycle theorem makes each pairwise zero sum one 3-cycle plus one q-cycle. Modulo the smaller alphabet, a nonconstant column therefore has one exceptional three-row subset. The new simultaneous-column argument proves that all such subsets coincide. If any higher quotient phase remains, restrictions to those three rows must be pairwise orthogonal: a same-phase pair is either orthogonal or proportional, and proportionality would repeat one root three times in a two-cycle zero sum. Thus an essential higher phase permits at most three columns.

The transformation is explicit double dephasing, and every two-by-two cross ratio must lie in mu_(3q). A three-column construction combines a phased three-row Fourier block with q Fourier rows. Its Gram is diagonal, but one cross ratio is a primitive higher-order root. This proves that the four-column hypothesis cannot be reduced to three.

Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-prime-alphabet-descent
```

Both modes print:

```text
PASS_TWO_PRIME_ALPHABET_DESCENT
At least four orthogonal columns with q+3 rows descend from mu_(3^a*q^b) to mu_(3q)
Exact eight-row capacity four for all a,b>=1; three-column boundary is sharp
Exact quotient-pattern, prime-cycle, Fourier-line, cross-ratio and lifted-attainment checks pass
Unchanged complete fifteenth-root capacity and nested source checks pass
```

New exact checks cover 10,272 canonical quotient patterns, 173,600 full subset-pair cases and all 14,400 prime-cycle pairs in eight alphabets of orders 15,45,75,225,21,63,147,441. Exact cyclotomic basis lookup finds every normalized three-root zero sum. The three-column counterexamples, higher-phase cross ratios, lifted four-column attainment and row/column phase recovery give 200 exact Gram checks. A composite-q=6 pattern shows why the quotient-count proof excludes that size. These checks support the written universal proof; they do not enumerate all matrices or replace the classical cycle theorem.

All 28 retained files are authenticated. The complete fifteenth-root capacity verifier runs unchanged, including the 95-vertex extension graph, exhaustive triangle exclusion, attaining matrix and nested predecessor replays. Normal/optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44450387971/job/135312578923) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Ali Romman (@aliromman) supplied [PR #7769](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7769)'s [finite capacity proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6dbe6e9503f26189833d5ef213aee708679835f2/research/fifteenth-root-column-capacity/PROOF.md), [certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6dbe6e9503f26189833d5ef213aee708679835f2/research/fifteenth-root-column-capacity/RESULT.json) and [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6dbe6e9503f26189833d5ef213aee708679835f2/research/fifteenth-root-column-capacity/verify.py), building on [PR #7762](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7762)'s [eight-root census](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d33fe8562c86888307cbba4a2aa92490212c8d78/research/mixed-cycle-column-obstruction/PROOF.md). [PR #7768](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7768)'s [general defect bound](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fefebaf8285f3c46f75a815657acbf48780763fb/research/mixed-cycle-column-defect/PROOF.md) motivated the attainment question but is not used in the new descent proof.

Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied [PR #7744](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7744)'s [two-prime completion question and projection](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7dc85513e8ee9b771a5856f027cf199936f85af0/research/two-prime-column-completion/README.md). T. Y. Lam and K. H. Leung supplied the classical input in [On Vanishing Sums of Roots of Unity, Corollary 3.4](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/9511209#page=8). All earlier notices, completion credit and atlas credit remain intact.

Other row counts, a third prime divisor, approximate orthogonality, full equivalence classification, native preparation and complete caller prices remain outside the result. The source capacity remains a finite certificate; no selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human acceptance or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged. No global literature priority is claimed.
